alkylation_concentration.evidence: Alkylation to reduce cysteine bonds was performed with 0.05 M iodoacetamide (IAA, Sigma).

cleavage_agent.evidence: Trypsin was added to the sample at a 1:50 ratio, and the sample was incubated at 37°C overnight.

collision_energy.evidence: Precursor ions were fragmented with a normalized collision energy (NCE) of 30.

fractionation_method.evidence: The samples were pooled together and fractionated into 7 fractions by Accucore™ 150 C18 LC Columns (150 mm x 2.1 mm, 4 µm) on the Agilent 1100 series HPLC system.
